movie.title: Succubus
movie.overview: A new father going through a marital separation joins a dating app and matches with a beautiful but mysterious young woman... whose powers of seduction and manipulation entangle him in a mystery more horrifying than he could have ever imagined.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A struggling new father seeking connection through a dating app falls under the spell of a captivating woman whose supernatural manipulation turns his life into a waking nightmare.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Separated from his wife and navigating the pressures of new fatherhood, a man turns to a dating app in search of an escape. He matches with a remarkably charming and alluring woman who quickly draws him into her orbit. As their relationship deepens, her seductive charm gives way to terrifying psychological and supernatural manipulation. He soon finds himself trapped in a dangerous Web of dark secrets that threatens his sanity and survival.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Reeling from a difficult marital separation and the overwhelming stress of new fatherhood, Chris attempts to rebuild his confidence by joining a dating app. His search leads him to match with a stunning and enigmatic woman who immediately captivates him with her hypnotic charm. What begins as a welcome distraction quickly evolves into an intense, intoxicating romance that isolates Chris from his friends and family. Unbeknownst to him, his new partner possesses ancient supernatural abilities designed to exploit his deepest vulnerabilities and insecurities. As unusual and terrifying occurrences begin to surround them, Chris experiences unsettling hallucinations and severe loss of control over his own life. The line between reality and obsession blurs as he realizes he has been systematically targeted by a predatory entity. Trapped in a web of dark rituals and psychological torment, Chris must confront the true, horrific nature of the woman he let into his life. Desperate to protect himself and what remains of his family, he scrambles to break her hold before he is completely consumed by her malevolent force.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Succubus is a psychological horror thriller that delves into the vulnerabilities of modern relationships, isolation, and digital intimacy. The story follows a vulnerable new father coping with a recent separation from his wife who attempts to find a fresh start through online dating. When he matches with an irresistibly attractive and mysterious young woman, he is rapidly drawn into a passionate affair. However, her mesmerizing allure hides a sinister truth: she is a predatory force with terrifying powers of seduction and manipulation. As her influence over his mind and environment grows, the protagonist becomes entangled in a dark and escalating mystery, turning his quest for affection into a desperate fight to regain control of his life and sanity.

story_structure.climax: The protagonist is forced to face the horrifying reality of her true nature in a high-stakes confrontation that threatens his sanity and survival.
story_structure.conflict: He matches with an extraordinarily captivating and mysterious young woman, but her seductive charm quickly gives way to subtle manipulation that destabilizes his life.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the ordeal, he is left to grapple with the disturbing psychological scars of the encounter as he attempts to piece his life back together.
story_structure.introduction: A new father, struggling with the emotional fallout of a recent marital separation, seeks a fresh start and joins an online dating app.
story_structure.risingAction: As he becomes increasingly enticed by her presence, strange and disturbing phenomena begin to surround him, entangling him in a web of psychological control and sinister secrets.
